scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 dist-electron/electron/main.js && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && vite build
